I wrote the profile settings form to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it's untested. I also didn't open `button.tsx`, `input.tsx` or `label.tsx` — I used them on the strength of `WORKSPACE.md`, so their props and styling are unchecked.

- **Display name:** a text field with the hint "Shown to your crew." The hint is linked to the field with `aria-describedby`.
- **Time zone:** a select with the placeholder "Choose a time zone" and the options UTC, Berlin and Tokyo.
- **Email switch:** a switch labelled "Email me about new orbits". The label sits in the same row as the switch.
- **Save button:** a primary "Save profile" button submits the form. After saving, "Profile saved." appears in a status line. Changing any field clears that line until the next save.
- **Branding:** the page us
